binary.validation: cross-compiled and linked; not executed on Windows
binary.runtimeDependency: A separately supplied, checksum-verified FFmpeg build with gdigrab and libx264 is required; FFmpeg is not embedded.

rustUnitTests.scope: Linux execution: pure display topology/epoch/geometry tests, strict control parsing, real temporary-file tools I/O with explicit native adapters, lifecycle/cancellation/release regressions, and one actual OS child termination/wait test. Windows native APIs are compiled but not executed. Seven new tests exercise phone-setup serialization/origin/identity bounds, actual UI-thread exit/panic cancellation, work-area fitting and focus-scroll geometry; no Win32 UI executed.

captureSmoke.scope: Network-free generated test bars. The production args/Annex-B parser and real encoder/decoder run; native Windows capture, SendInput, or WebRTC transport are not exercised.
captureSmoke.currentVersionNote: Executed for 0.4 only; not rerun in 0.5. Encoder/configuration/fixture source bytes match the archived input pins. This is not native Windows or networked media evidence.

webrtcMediaTransport.reason: independent runtime harness hit EPERM while opening required sockets/network interface inspection; no transmitted/decoded network frames claimed
webrtcMediaTransport.currentVersionNote: Blocked 0.2 fixture was not retried in 0.5. No networked video/input success is asserted.

whitespace.command: git diff --check -- agent-windows/src agent-windows/Cargo.toml agent-windows/Cargo.lock agent-windows/README.md

nativeWindowsSessionTools.reason: No Windows desktop is available. Clipboard ownership, delayed rendering, protected owner/SYSTEM ACLs, reparse handling, alternate-stream sharing, handle rename, and native cleanup require Windows device execution.

toolsOverWebRtc.reason: Workspace socket/interface policy already blocked the networked media harness; no retry or policy bypass was attempted. Protocol and storage unit tests do not establish live DataChannel interoperability.

nativeWindowsDisplays.reason: No Windows desktop is available. Exact-FFmpeg mixed-DPI capture/cursor alignment, negative-origin monitor selection, portrait/rotation/hotplug behavior, consent placement and physical SendInput mapping require real-device validation.

osChildReaping.scope: Production reap_encoder starts termination and waits on a real /bin/sleep child; the test checks completed wait and cleared child process ID. This is Linux OS process evidence, not Windows process evidence.

teardownRegressions.scope: Synthetic signaling/session panics, delayed capture cleanup, timeout ownership, stale nonterminal handover state, cancellation while holding the input mutex, and retained failed key/Unicode/button release state. Actual Windows input/peer closure and relay transport remain unexecuted.

nativeWindowsHostHome.reason: No Windows desktop runner available. Required physical checks: work-area fit at short/high-DPI and negative-origin monitors, DPI migration, Tab/Enter/Escape, clipboard busy/failure, startup failure, close during active control/upload, and teardown confirmation.

phoneSetupContract.scope: Cross-platform pure unit tests and Windows compilation only. Five exact serialization/origin/identity/thread-cancellation tests plus work-area/focus geometry tests. Android link dispatch/import and actual Windows clipboard remain device gates.

initialCompilation.note: Draft native API module/type errors retained separately from final passing checks.

sourceInputs.algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON mapping relative paths to content SHA-256, sorted keys, compact separators
sourceInputs.scope: Cargo manifest/lock, all Rust source files, and both examples; README and this evidence record are not build inputs.
